title: Binary Answer Machine
statement: For every natural number $k$ and Boolean value $b$, define a $k$-work-tape Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with two states, numbered $0$ and $1$. Its initial state is $0$, and in state $q$ every transition uses the action that emits the one-symbol word consisting of $b$ and has successor state $q$.
caveat: The supplied definitions do not specify all components of the helper action `emitAction`.
